definition: to wish for something and expect it to happen
description: A young woman leans over a terracotta flowerpot standing on a bright white windowsill. The pot holds only dark soil and nothing has come up yet. She waters it with a small metal can, then waits, biting her lip and pressing her clasped hands to her mouth, staring at the empty soil with an anxious face. Then a tiny green sprout pushes up through the soil; her eyes go wide, she gasps and finally smiles and cups her hands around the pot.

en.question: What is growing in the flowerpot?
